an_tip_gap.message: Time between two reels (median ignores long pauses).

an_tip_active.message: Share of days with at least one reel.

an_ai_trend_restart.message: Silent for a month, now $1 reels: active again.

an_ai_trend_up.message: Pace is rising: $1 reels in the last 30 days vs $2 in the 30 before. Often a new product test or pushing a winner.

an_ai_trend_down.message: Pace is dropping: $1 reels in the last 30 days vs $2 in the 30 before.

an_ai_trend_flat.message: Pace is steady: $1 reels in the last 30 days vs $2 in the 30 before.

an_ai_best_day.message: Best results on $1: median $2 views ($3 reels) vs $4 overall.

an_ai_best_time.message: Best time slot $1: median $2 views ($3 reels).

an_ai_multi_worse.message: Days with 2+ reels get median $1 views vs $2 on single-post days — posting more splits the views.

an_ai_multi_better.message: Days with 2+ reels get median $1 views vs $2 on single-post days — posting more doesn't hurt this profile.

an_ai_multi_same.message: No real difference in median views between 2+ post days ($1) and single-post days ($2).

an_ai_truncated.message: Only the latest $1 reels were analyzed. Raise the limit for more history.

an_tip_strong.message: Clearly above typical (≈ top 16%), not viral.

an_tip_winner.message: Strong reach + more engagement than that reach usually gets: the best sign of a product with demand.

an_tip_high_er.message: Engagement far above what this reach usually gets (z ≥ 2).

an_method_few.message: Needs at least 8 reels with views.

an_method_why.message: Why not '3× median' or '2× average'? Views on social video are heavy-tailed (a few reels get most of the views). A fixed multiplier then means something different on every profile: on a steady account '3× median' is almost never reached, on a volatile one it labels 1 in 5 reels viral. The average is pulled up by the hits themselves, so 'above average' is simply the top ~30%. So this tool measures how unusual a reel is for this profile, on a log scale, with outlier-resistant statistics.

an_method_baseline_local.message: Typical views = the median of the ~30 reels posted closest in time to each reel. A growing (or shrinking) account is compared with its own level at that moment, not with its whole history.

an_method_baseline_global.message: Typical views = the median of all analyzed reels (fewer than 20 reels, so no time-local baseline).

an_method_tiers.message: This profile's spread (robust standard deviation of log views, from the median absolute deviation) is $1. Strong = at least $2 typical views (z ≥ 1, about the top 16%). Viral = at least $3 typical views (z ≥ 2, about the top 2%). Viral is never below 3× and strong never below 1.5×, so a steady account doesn't call a small bump viral.

an_method_eng.message: Engagement is judged against reach, because on real profiles they move together: here log(likes + comments) grows with log(views) with slope $1 (1.0 would mean the engagement rate doesn't depend on views; above 1 = reels with more views also get a higher rate). A robust (Theil–Sen) line gives the expected engagement for every view count; 'ER vs expected' is the difference from that line, and its robust z decides High engagement (z ≥ 2) and Winner (strong or viral reach + z ≥ 1). Comments get their own line (slope $2: below 1 = the comment rate falls as reach grows).

an_method_new.message: Reels younger than 3 days are still collecting views: they are marked NEW, left out of the baselines and never called weak.

an_ins_winner.message: $1 winners: strong reach + strong engagement. Check these products first.

an_ins_viral_low_er.message: $1 viral reels got weak engagement (watched, not acted on).

an_ins_talk.message: $1 reels get unusually many comments: read them for buying questions.

an_sig_viral_tip.message: z = $1 (≥ 2): about the top 2% for this profile.

an_sig_strong_tip.message: z = $1 (≥ 1): about the top 16% for this profile.

an_sig_weak_tip.message: z ≤ −1: clearly below typical for this profile.

an_sig_new_tip.message: Posted less than 3 days ago: still collecting views.

an_sig_winner_tip.message: Strong or viral reach and engagement above what that reach normally gets (z ≥ 1).

an_sig_high_er_tip.message: Engagement $1 vs $2 expected for this reach; z = $3 (≥ 2).

an_sig_talk_tip.message: Comments per view z = $1 (≥ 2) for this reach, and at least 5 comments.

an_tip_eradj.message: ER $1 · expected for this reach $2 · z = $3

an_method_tail.message: Viral rate on this profile: $1 of reels. A pure log-normal (no real virality) would give about 2%; anything clearly above that is a genuine viral tail.

an_method_dates.message: Instagram's reels list doesn't return post dates any more, so dates are decoded from each reel's shortcode (the media ID contains its creation time). Accurate to the minute for normal posts.
